name: Decentralised Adapter-Based LLM Inference — Systematic Literature Review (manuscript, curated corpus & PRISMA evidence)
description: Manuscript and curated evidence for a systematic literature review of decentralised, adapter-based LLM inference at the intersection of PEFT, P2P/federated systems and multi-task serving. Follows PRISMA 2020 reporting and Wohlin (2014) citation snowballing over a 123-record corpus. Ships the MDPI manuscript (LaTeX), the curated G0-G6 corpus, the PRISMA 2020 checklist, quality-appraisal scoring, and supporting search exports and provenance.
